chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: The likeness of the weapon among us is only like the likeness of the Ark among the Children of Isrāʾīl: wherever the Ark turned, the kingdom turned; and wherever the weapon turns among us, knowledge turns.

key_terms.التَّابُوتِ: the Ark, cited as the parallel sign among the Children of Isrāʾīl
key_terms.السِّلَاحِ: the weapon, presented here as a sign associated with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْعِلْمُ: divinely granted knowledge associated with rightful authority
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Isrāʾīl, cited as the historical analogy
key_terms.مَثَلُ: the likeness or parable used for comparison

ai.seo_question: How does the hadith compare the weapon of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام to the Ark of Banī Isrāʾīl?
ai.summary: This hadith compares the weapon possessed by the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام to the Ark among the Children of Isrāʾīl, as a sign bound to rightful authority and divine endowment. It indicates that among them, the presence of the weapon signifies the locus of sacred knowledge and legitimate leadership.
